# PRT021 `star-kind`

<Badge type="warning" text="warning" /> <Badge type="tip" text="enabled by default" />

A non-standard `type*size` declaration (`real*8`, `integer*4`).

## Why

`real*8` is a common extension, never part of the standard. Use a kind parameter:
`real(real64)`.

## Reported

```fortran
real*8 :: x
```

## Preferred

```fortran
real(real64) :: x
```

## Suppressing

For one occurrence, with the reason on the same line (or alone on the line before the statement):

```fortran
! fobis: ignore[PRT021] <why this occurrence is fine>
```

For the whole project, `ignore = PRT021` in the fobos [`[lint]` section](/cookbook/analysis#choose-the-rules).
